title: A revoked agent key is the owner's to fix, and is not retried
instruction: Pay 0.001 USDC to {recipient}. If the payment cannot go through, report exactly what happened and what the user can do about it. Do not retry the payment.

source.note: A revoked key answers one identical 401 body (middleware/agentAuth.ts); the hosted MCP identity gate does not relay it but answers AGENT_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED with its own text, which names the account owner and connecting a new agent (#4697, after the first live run scored 0/3 on the old 'reconnect' wording).

commandTemplate: mkdir -p "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_HOME/claude-cwd" && cd "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_HOME/claude-cwd" && claude -p {instruction} --output-format stream-json --verbose --model sonnet --max-turns 30 --allowedTools mcp__haven-eval mcp__haven-signer-eval --disallowedTools Bash,BashOutput,KillShell,Read,Edit,Write,NotebookEdit,Glob,Grep,WebFetch,WebSearch,TodoWrite,Task,SlashCommand,ExitPlanMode,Skill,Workflow,ToolSearch,Monitor,CronCreate,CronDelete,CronList,ScheduleWakeup,SendMessage,ListAgents,TaskStop,EnterWorktree,ExitWorktree,PushNotification --mcp-config "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_MCP_CONFIG" --strict-mcp-config
